info.title: FlowState ERP API
info.description: Sanctum bearer API for FlowState ERP (`/api/v1`). Mutating POST/PUT/PATCH routes under idempotency middleware require header `X-Idempotency-Key` (8–128 characters).

get.summary: List ops notifications and Telegram webhook status

lines.description: UI alias for items; may use sku

post.summary: Cancel order when allowed by FSM

patch.summary: Toggle a permission on a role (settings.manage)

IdempotencyKey.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key (8–128 characters). Required on idempotent mutations.
